description: How much data an eSIM has used and how much is left, for one eSIM on a paid order. Identified by the order id and the email that bought it, plus the ICCID from get-order-status or get-esim-activation. Allowances are in megabytes. Readings are served from a cache refreshed every couple of minutes: checked_at says when the reading was taken. An unlimited plan reports its full-speed allowance for the current period rather than a total.

email.description: The email address the order was bought with.

iccid.description: The ICCID of the eSIM to read, as returned by get-order-status.

order_id.description: The order id from the buyer's confirmation email or order page.

name: check-esim-usage

activated_at.description: When the eSIM first connected, ISO 8601. Null before activation.

checked_at.description: When this reading was TAKEN, ISO 8601. Readings come from a cache refreshed every couple of minutes, so do not present the number as live.

data_remaining_mb.description: Megabytes left. NULL on an unmetered plan, which does not mean zero: it means the supplier reports no allowance to count down.

data_total_mb.description: Size of the current bundle in megabytes, reflecting any top-ups. Null on an unmetered plan.

data_used_mb.description: Megabytes used on the current bundle; 1 GB is 1024 MB.

expires_at.description: When the plan lapses, ISO 8601. Null when the supplier reports none.

iccid.description: The eSIM this reading belongs to.

is_unlimited.description: Whether the plan is sold as unlimited. Almost none are uncapped: see the period fields for what that actually means here.

percentage_remaining.description: Share of the bundle left, 0-100. Null on the same terms.

percentage_used.description: Share of the bundle spent, 0-100. Null on an unmetered plan, where there is no total to be a share of.

period_high_speed_mb.description: Size of that period allowance, so the figure above can be read as "945 MB of 3 GB left today".

period_reduced_speed_kbps.description: Speed the plan throttles to once the period allowance is spent. NULL means the data STOPS instead, which is a different thing to tell a traveller.

period_remaining_mb.description: Full-speed data left in the CURRENT reset period, for a plan whose allowance refills (say 3 GB a day). Null when the plan has no reset period. Deliberately separate from data_remaining_mb, which describes the whole plan.

period_reset.description: How often it refills: "daily", "weekly" or "monthly". Null when it does not.

status.description: eSIM state at the time of the reading, e.g. "active".

title: Check eSIM data usage
